{{Quote|I can't believe you went to these lengths to rescue us. Thank you.|Ortis|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ortis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] from [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] who designed the [[Barrager]] superweapon together with fellow Doctor [[Otak'or Meln]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] took over Balmorra, Meln and Ortis were thrown into [[Gorinth Brig]], while the Barrager was left unfinished. In [[3642 BBY]], they were rescued from imprisonment by a Republic citizen and provided their help in getting the now complete Barrager into [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] hands.
